about: A plain description for each capability id in the five abp.sgit.ai examples, in the source's own words: the label of each primitive in the capability grammar verb.object.reach (what-can-it-do.games.sgit.ai/data/primitives.json, which abp.sgit.ai's upstream pack names as its base), with what its reach means in general and in each example, and each example's own note on its row. For deck, for E02 v3 and E09. Built by researcher@the-ultimate-insider, 29 October 2026, 10:15 UTC.
cautions: Every id has a label in the source: no description here is the researcher's own. Where E02 v2 used its own words, the label can replace them.

The same id means different things in different examples: host is 'your machine, as your user account' for Claude Code, 'the runner, destroyed after the job' for the CI runner, 'your browser, every page, every logged-in site' for the extension. Use in_examples[].reach_in_this_example, not only the general reach.
The grammar's source is 'brief v0.33.64' (4 September 2026), and the primitives and examples are one author's network: the descriptions are definitions, not evidence that anything was measured.

reaches.self: the agent's own process, sandbox or turn
reaches.project: the working tree or workspace it was pointed at
reaches.host: the machine, container or account it runs as
reaches.tenant: the organisation's accounts, repositories and services
